launches.title: TovenAI: Your intelligent compliance stack for finance
launches.tagline: AI agents for compliance at institutional trading firms that understand firm policies, analyze activity across systems, and surface what matters most
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Compliance teams at institutional trading firms still spend hours manually sifting through mountains of data across recorded calls, chats, and trade records to investigate activity and produce defensible audit trails. Determining what matters requires not only finding the right data, but also interpreting activity against applicable regulations and the firm’s own policies and procedures. TovenAI is building a platform of AI agents that connects to their systems, assembles the evidence, and surfaces what matters for compliance teams at these firms—think the sales and trading businesses at banks like Bank of America and specialist brokerages like Marex.

We are live at one of the top 10 institutional trading firms in the U.S., with multiple AI agents delivering value through our platform.

<https://youtu.be/02IMKFk38IU>

## **What we built**

TovenAI’s agents analyze activity across existing communications and trading systems using each firm’s policies, procedures, and applicable regulations as context, assembling the relevant evidence for compliance teams.

Our trade-reconstruction agent rebuilds the full sequence of a trade, links every event to its source evidence, and reduces the process from around four hours to minutes. Our electronic-communications surveillance agent reduces the false-positive burden by 3× and, in a head-to-head evaluation, delivered roughly 7× more value per alert reviewed than the market-leading incumbent.

Our platform supports several other compliance workflows, giving teams broader coverage with less manual work.

With prebuilt integrations to more than 30 systems – including Bloomberg, Cloud9, CME and NICE Actimize – firms can evaluate TovenAI on their own data in under a week without replacing their existing stack.

## **Why us**

We met eight years ago at Stanford. Batu later worked as a quantitative research engineer at Citadel Global Quantitative Strategies, building AI systems for quantitative research. Sam was a machine learning engineer at Meta, working on its ads recommendation systems.

We work closely with our customers and sit besides compliance officers every day. This gives us a rapid feedback loop, lets us see their workflows firsthand, and allows us to redesign compliance operations with AI at their core.

Sam’s mother spent her 15-year career in risk and compliance and was our first sounding board as we began exploring the space.

## **Our ask**

We would love introductions to compliance leaders at firms with institutional trading businesses.

Think the sales and trading divisions of banks like **JPMorgan, Bank of America, Citizens**, as well as specialist brokerages like **TP ICAP and Marex**. We are interested in firms of all sizes, from specialist brokerages to the largest global banks.

If you know a broker or trader at one of these firms, they can likely connect us with someone on their compliance team.

A one-line introduction is enough, and we will take it from there.

Email us at: [**founders@toven.ai**](mailto:founders@toven.ai)

Learn more about us at <https://toven.ai>.
